Just now, an important reminder for first-time travelers
It concerns the desk
Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers should know that pet check-in and relief steps need a little extra care before departure, and I am sorry for any confusion that may have come up. Please read the desk guidance closely so your trip stays calm for you and your animal.

At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, staff will help with document checks, crate guidance, and the basic handoff steps for cabin or hold travel. <<FACT F019>> Bring any required pet papers, keep carriers closed until asked otherwise, and make sure your animal is calm and secure while you wait. If you are traveling with Toby or another pet, the desk team can point you to the right lane and the right waiting area.

For passengers using the relief area, please follow the posted directions and stay with your animal at all times. <<FACT F014>> If anything looks unclear, let the desk know right away so it can be corrected before boarding. That small check helps avoid delays and keeps the process fair for everyone.

Please go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk before boarding for help and a final review of your travel needs.
